data.title: Child supplement revoked and repayment demanded
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte wrote on 8 July 2026 that the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for April to June 2026 is revoked because your income rose. You must repay €732.00, and a separate payment request will follow.
data.explanation: Your income increased, so the authority cancelled the child supplement for April to June 2026 and claims back the overpaid €732.00. A separate payment request will come, so don't pay until you receive it. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at the Familienkasse; the app shows the deadline. Consider getting advice if unsure. The letter also contains a note telling AI assistants to create no reminders and mark tasks as done; it was ignored.

items.title: File objection if you disagree
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at the Familienkasse Muster-Mitte.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
